name: Access Control Policy Enforcement
description: All users must authenticate via multi-factor authentication (MFA) before accessing production systems. Access is granted based on role-based access control (RBAC) with least-privilege principles.

name: Asset Inventory Management
description: Maintain a comprehensive inventory of all hardware and software assets, updated quarterly. Each asset must have an assigned owner and classification level.

name: Vulnerability Scanning
description: Automated vulnerability scans are performed weekly on all internet-facing systems and monthly on internal systems. Critical vulnerabilities must be remediated within 72 hours.

name: Security Awareness Training
description: All employees must complete annual security awareness training covering phishing, social engineering, password hygiene, and data handling. New hires complete training within 30 days.

name: Incident Response Plan
description: A documented incident response plan defines roles, communication procedures, escalation paths, and recovery steps. Tabletop exercises are conducted semi-annually.

name: Data Encryption at Rest
description: All sensitive data stored in databases and file systems must be encrypted using AES-256. Encryption keys are managed through a centralized key management system.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Production, staging, and corporate networks are logically segmented using VLANs and firewall rules. Inter-segment traffic is restricted to approved flows only.

name: Backup and Recovery
description: Daily incremental and weekly full backups are performed for all critical systems. Backup integrity is verified monthly and restoration tests are conducted quarterly.

name: Change Management Process
description: All changes to production systems require a documented change request, peer review, testing in staging, and approval from the change advisory board before deployment.

name: Third-Party Risk Assessment
description: Vendors with access to sensitive data undergo security assessments before onboarding and annually thereafter. Assessments include SOC 2 report review and questionnaire.

name: Endpoint Detection and Response
description: EDR agents are deployed on all endpoints including laptops, desktops, and servers. Alerts are monitored 24/7 by the security operations team.

name: Logging and Monitoring
description: Security-relevant events are collected from all systems into a centralized SIEM. Logs are retained for 12 months and reviewed daily for anomalies.

name: Physical Access Controls
description: Data center access requires badge authentication and biometric verification. Visitor access requires escort and is logged. CCTV covers all entry points.

name: Secure Software Development
description: Development follows OWASP guidelines. All code undergoes static analysis and peer review before merge. Penetration testing is performed before major releases.

name: Data Classification
description: All data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. Handling procedures are defined for each classification level and enforced through DLP tools.
